additionalVerifiedProperties: Previously settled local consumption and signed model/price configuration survive handoff
Pending local usage prevents handoff and does not destroy the original local task
Twenty concurrent reservation attempts across two receiver runtimes share exactly three 150-token holds under a 450-token cap
Prepared cancellations refund; dispatched unknown usage preserves holds and freezes every receiver
Wrong served model and bound breaches cannot be accepted as cheaper or zero usage
Repeated reserve/dispatch/settle requests do not duplicate accounting; reservation IDs are grant-bound
Expired prepared leases refund while a healthy sibling remains usable
Expired dispatched leases quarantine a healthy sibling
Expired ancestor quarantines a descendant's pending usage even if the descendant renewed its own lease
Receiver cannot replace authoritative limits with an independent local UsageLimits
Generic unmetered model invocation is denied before native execution
Source local snapshot is explicitly marked transferred; authority Root exposes current shared snapshot
Protocol authenticates lease ownership, rejects root management operations and enforces exact fields
Snapshot decoder rejects null/coerced accounting fields instead of interpreting missing counters as zero
